description: Source code for the ConnectTunnel class implementing a TCP proxy tunnel for QUIC, handling connection setup, data transfer, and stream management.

classes.name: ConnectTunnel
classes.description: Manages a TCP connection tunnel for QUIC, handling connection establishment, data transfer, and stream termination.

methods.name: OpenTunnel
methods.description: Initiates the tunnel based on request headers, validates headers and authority, establishes TCP connection, and responds to client.

methods.name: IsConnectedToDestination
methods.description: Checks if the tunnel is currently connected to the destination server.

methods.name: SendDataToDestination
methods.description: Sends data to the destination server through the established TCP socket.

methods.name: OnClientStreamClose
methods.description: Handles closure of the client stream, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ConnectComplete
methods.description: Callback for completion of connection; not expected to be called asynchronously.

methods.name: ReceiveComplete
methods.description: Handles data received from the destination server.

methods.name: SendComplete
methods.description: Callback for completion of data send; not expected to be called asynchronously.

methods.name: BeginAsyncReadFromDestination
methods.description: Starts asynchronous read operation from the destination socket.

methods.name: OnDestinationConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles closure of the destination connection.

methods.name: SendConnectResponse
methods.description: Sends a 200 OK response to establish the tunnel.

methods.name: TerminateClientStream
methods.description: Terminates the client stream with an error code and message.
